bug_fixed.description: Fixed bug in apply-preset-to-user and apply-preset-to-group endpoints where MongoDB query with projection returned empty dict {} for users/groups without cap_grants/capabilities field, and 'if not u:' evaluated to True for empty dict
bug_fixed.root_cause: Empty dict {} is falsy in Python, so 'if not u:' returned True even when user existed
bug_fixed.fix: Changed 'if not u:' to 'if u is None:' and added user_id/group_id to projection to ensure non-empty result
